Q186.reason: Res ipsa loquitur applies because the elevator was under the owner's exclusive control and a sudden fall ordinarily does not occur without negligence, so the case goes to the jury.

Q187.reason: Selling gasoline is an ordinary commercial transaction, and knowing the buyer will misuse it is generally not enough to impose criminal liability on the seller.

Q188.reason: The recorded negative covenant binds the daughter as a successor with constructive notice, and the man and neighbor's original adjacent-lot privity supports enforcement, so the gift is irrelevant.
